calibrated-2025-13m-city-bev-auxiliary-p.name: auxiliary power base demand
calibrated-2025-13m-city-bev-auxiliary-p.comment: 2025 generic 13m-city BEV transfer from Gillig Altoona 2020-05. Rounded 8.3 kW base auxiliary demand fitted on OCBC and HD-UDDS; Manhattan held out. Fits span 8279.7-8393.1 W for reported motor-rating bounds 262.5-562.5 kW. HVAC was off; this excludes separately modelled heating/cooling. Triangular bounds +/-25% (6225-10375 W) retain the previous relative engineering uncertainty; they are NOT an empirical confidence interval. Single-bus transfer to depot, opportunity and in-motion charging is an assumption; measured vehicle-specific inputs should override it.
